cycle.description: 甲子 combines Yang Wood (甲), traditionally associated with initiative, growth and outward development, and the Rat branch (子, Water). It is one of the 60 positions in the repeating 干支 cycle.
乙丑 combines Yin Wood (乙), traditionally associated with adaptation, cultivation and gradual growth, and the Ox branch (丑, Earth). It is one of the 60 positions in the repeating 干支 cycle.
丙寅 combines Yang Fire (丙), traditionally associated with visibility, warmth and outward expression, and the Tiger branch (寅, Wood). It is one of the 60 positions in the repeating 干支 cycle.
丁卯 combines Yin Fire (丁), traditionally associated with focused illumination, refinement and attentiveness, and the Rabbit branch (卯, Wood). It is one of the 60 positions in the repeating 干支 cycle.
